title.zh: 酒类管制（供应与消费）（豁免）命令 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Liquor Control (Supply and Consumption) (Exemption) Order 2017 and comes into operation on 1 August 2017.

1A. In this Order, “telecommunication service” has the meaning given by section 2 of the Telecommunications Act 1999.
[S 719/2023 wef 02/01/2024]

3.—(1) Where —
(a)licensed premises are specified in a liquor licence; and
(b)the licensee also supplies liquor online or through a telecommunication service,
[S 719/2023 wef 02/01/2024]
the licensee is exempted from section 5(1) of the Act for the sale of liquor online or through the telecommunication service.
[S 719/2023 wef 02/01/2024]
(2) A licensee is exempted from section 5(1) of the Act for the delivery of liquor to —
(a)any other licensed premises; or
(b)a place that is not a public place.

4.—(1) Where —
(a)licensed premises are specified in a liquor licence; and
(b)the licensee also supplies liquor online or through a telecommunication service,
[S 719/2023 wef 02/01/2024]
the licensee is exempted from section 6(1)(a) of the Act for the sale of liquor online or through the telecommunication service outside of the trading hours applicable to the licensee.
[S 719/2023 wef 02/01/2024]
(2) A licensee is exempted from section 6(1)(a) of the Act for the delivery of liquor, outside of the trading hours applicable to the licensee, to —
(a)any other licensed premises; or
(b)a place that is not a public place.
